actual: On runtime identity 41504a205b9372a4e709587dc2310fd8143c6c6d, two independent MA-E14 durable runs (macb_idem_6ebaee4ec80242a3632bae7c79efcf1abff9d358 and macb_idem_67bda61e726d6b371e5f5fc158ad63690542f401) failed while materializing their only orthogonality_aware child. Both recorded ReadOnlySqlTransaction: cannot execute UPDATE in a read-only transaction. The first then overwrote the primary failure at parent finalization with multi_alpha_row_version_conflict; the second ended multi_alpha_no_successful_scheme. Expected: a connection returned from any read-only control-plane operation cannot contaminate later durable writes; child materialization must run in a writable transaction, primary errors remain attributable, and row-version CAS still fails closed without hiding the root cause. Preserve QE file-only data plane and control/result DB use; no DDL/DML migration and no process control.
